name: Evolve Asure
one_liner: A unified platform for showcasing and managing projects with role-based access.
description: A single-platform solution at evolveasure.in that provides a concise public showcase of the studio's vertical, with everything operational (projects, dashboards, data) behind a sign-in. Access is requested by users, reviewed by the owner, and granted based on their role; no public self-registration. Signed-in users see only the projects they're entitled to.
